claim: Southern Ridges spans ~10km linking five parks; Henderson Waves is Singapore's highest pedestrian bridge at 36m.
quote: the Southern Ridges comprises one of the most stunning hiking trails in Singapore, spanning a total length of 10km... Henderson Waves... at 36 metres... is the highest pedestrian bridge in Singapore.

claim: NParks rates the Southern Ridges DIY route 3-5 hours; it is free, open 24 hours and needs no permit.
quote: both of the above routes take an estimated 3-5 hours to complete... The Southern Ridges is free, open 24 hours, and requires zero permits.

claim: Bike rental on Pulau Ubin runs about S$8-15/day, with mountain bikes recommended for rough tracks.
quote: Rentals start from as low as S$8/day, with prices ranging between $8 to $15... upgrade to a mountain bike with better suspension.

claim: Bumboat to Pulau Ubin from Changi Point is S$4 (S$6 with own bike) and departs once 12 passengers board; bikes are not allowed on the Chek Jawa boardwalk.
quote: fares of S$4/person (or S$6 if bringing your own bike). The boat only leaves when there are 12 passengers... bicycles are not allowed at Chek Jawa boardwalk.

claim: Chek Jawa Wetlands offers a mangrove boardwalk and Jejawi Tower viewpoint on Pulau Ubin.
quote: Chek Jawa Wetlands... mangrove boardwalk and Jejawi Tower.

claim: The HSBC TreeTop Walk in Central Catchment is a free-standing suspension bridge reached via rainforest trails.
quote: Hiking and nature walks at Central Catchment Nature Reserve... TreeTop Walk.

claim: The MacRitchie Reservoir and TreeTop Walk loop is moderate, roughly 10-11km, averaging about 3 hours 21 minutes.
quote: moderate hike that covers 7.5 miles... takes an average of 3 hours and 21 minutes to complete.

claim: The TreeTop Walk bridge is ~250m long, up to 25m high, one-way only, and closed on Mondays.
quote: approximately 250 meters long and rising up to 25 meters... a strictly one-way system... The MacRitchie Treetop Walk is closed every Monday.

claim: From St John's Island a causeway leads ~15 min to Lazarus Beach (white sand, clear water); no shops or toilets, bring your own water.
quote: It takes about 15 minutes to walk from St John's Pier to Lazarus Beach... There are no cafes or shops on the island so you will need to bring your own food and enough water.

claim: Ferries to the Southern Islands (St John's, Lazarus, Kusu, Sisters') depart from Marina South Pier on a published schedule.
quote: Flexible Ferry Schedule | Lazarus, Kusu, Sisters' & St John's.

claim: Pulau Ubin mangrove kayaking is a ~4h beginner-friendly tandem trip with gear provided; min age 7, covered shoes required.
quote: This 4-hour adventure... beginner-friendly with all equipment and gear provided... Children must be at least 7 years old... Covered shoes are mandatory.

claim: Guided nature kayaking trips in Singapore's mangroves are bookable online via Klook.
quote: Nature Kayaking - Klook Singapore.

claim: East Coast Park has an ~11km coastal cycling stretch split into zones A-H with multiple rental shops.
quote: East Coast Park is 11 km long and is divided into eight different areas A to H.

claim: Bike rental at East Coast Park averages about S$10-12 per hour for an adult bike via chains like GoCycling.
quote: The average East Coast Park bike rental price is between $10 and $12 per hour for an adult bike.

claim: GoCycling is one of Singapore's largest bike rental chains with multiple East Coast Park outlets.
quote: GoCycling with Us!

claim: The Round Island Route is a continuous ~150km park connector circling Singapore.
quote: The Round Island Route (RIR) is a continuous 150km park connector.

claim: Actual Round Island ride distance ranges 110km (without Tuas) to 160km depending on route.
quote: it can be between 110km (without Tuas) to 160km (including Tuas and Lamp Post 1).

claim: The Coast-to-Coast Trail (Central) is a 36km route linking parks from Jurong Lake Gardens to Coney Island.
quote: a 36 km trail that spans across Singapore, linking up nature areas, parks and park connectors from Jurong Lake Gardens in the west... to Coney Island Park.

claim: Completing the Coast-to-Coast Trail end-to-end takes about 8 to 12 hours depending on pace.
quote: It takes between 8 and 12 hours to complete the Coast to Coast Trail.

claim: The Singapore River Cruise is a ~40-minute bumboat ride past the quays and Marina Bay, departing every 15 minutes 9am-11pm.
quote: approximately 40 minutes... operates from 9 am to 11 pm daily, with a boat departing every 15 minutes.

claim: Singapore River Cruise adult tickets run about S$24-28.
quote: ticket prices for the Singapore River Cruise are S$24.22 for adults... tickets cost $28 ($36 SGD) for adults.

claim: Night Safari is the world's first nocturnal park with a Safari Adventure Tram, 4 walking trails and 900+ animals.
quote: the world's first nocturnal wildlife park, where visitors can explore 4 walking trails and ride the Safari Adventure Tram to meet over 900 nocturnal creatures.

claim: Reviews note the Creatures of the Night keeper show and that walking trails are more engaging than the tram.
quote: some visitors found the walking experience to be better than the tram ride... The Creatures of the Night show introduces visitors to creatures like the binturong, fennec fox.

claim: Sisters' Islands Marine Park (Big Sister's Island) is open for nature walks; Small Sister's is closed for conservation.
quote: Hiking, nature walks or tours at Big Sister's Island.

claim: Sisters' Islands has 250+ hard-coral species and two dive trails (6m and 15m); diving requires Advanced cert with 20+ dives via NParks-approved operators.
quote: the Shallow Dive Trail, with a depth of 6 metres and the Deep Dive Trail, with a depth of 15 metres... only certified Advanced Divers with at least 20 dives... more than 250 species of hard corals.

claim: Sungei Buloh is a 202ha wetland reserve with free entry, flat boardwalks, and crocodiles, otters and monitor lizards.
quote: a 202-hectare ecological jewel... no entrance fee, easy flat trails and boardwalks... Estuarine Crocodiles, smooth-coated otters, and Malayan Water Monitor Lizards.

claim: Sungei Buloh offers free guided tours and is best in the Sep-Mar migratory season and early morning.
quote: Sungei Buloh offers free guided tours... The migratory season (September to March) is the best time to see migratory birds.

claim: Bukit Timah summit (163m) has a 1.2km easy red trail and steeper moderate-to-difficult green/yellow trails; round trip ~3km, under an hour at pace.
quote: The red trail is rated as 'easy' and is 1.2 kilometres... The green trail is rated as 'moderate to difficult'... a round trip of about 3 kilometres.

claim: The OCBC Skyway is an aerial walkway between the Supertrees, with tourist tickets around S$14.
quote: OCBC Skyway tickets start at SGD 5 for Singaporeans and SGD 8 for tourists... $14 for adults.

claim: The Supertree Observatory costs about S$14 adult.
quote: Supertree Observatory costs $14 for adults and $10 for children 3-12 years old.

claim: PAssion Wave @ Marina Bay rents kayaks, pedal boats and SUP on Marina Reservoir; SUP needs certification and it is closed Mondays.
quote: rental for pedal boating, kayaking, dragon boating, sailing, windsurfing, and stand-up paddling... closed on Mondays... Valid certification is required for... stand-up paddling.

claim: Skyline Luge is a gravity-fuelled ride with four trails (Dragon, Expedition, Kupu Kupu, Jungle) and a night-luge option.
quote: four different trails (Dragon, Expedition, Kupu Kupu and Jungle)... The Night Luge offers neon lights, glowing tracks.

claim: Sentosa Sensoryscape is a free 350m garden walkway with six sensory gardens, open 24 hours.
quote: Sentosa Sensoryscape features... a 350-metre garden walkway... Sentosa Sensoryscape is open 24 hours daily and is free to visit!

claim: Bintan Resort Ferries run from Singapore's Tanah Merah terminal to Bintan in roughly an hour, with same-day getaways around S$87.
quote: Bintan Resorts offers same-day getaways at just S$87 per pax.

claim: Bintan is reachable in ~60-70 min by ferry; Lagoi Beach offers kayaking, paddleboarding and mangrove boat tours.
quote: reach Bintan by ferry in roughly 60 minutes... Lagoi Beach... try water sports like kayaking or paddleboarding.

claim: Batam is a ~60-minute ferry day-trip from Singapore for beach and watersports.
quote: Day Trip to Batam: Ferries, itineraries & things to do.

claim: Jewel's Canopy Park (Level 5) has bouncing nets, slides, mazes and garden trails.
quote: Canopy Park, located at the topmost level (L5) of Jewel... mazes, bouncing nets, giant slides, and bowls of gentle mist.

claim: The Mastercard Canopy Bridge is suspended 23m up with a glass-bottomed, fog-wreathed centre.
quote: suspended 23 metres above ground with a glass bottom at the centre portion and fog emitted at both ends.

claim: Chestnut Nature Park has an 8.2km MTB trail graded easy to extremely difficult; novices should stick to the Northern loop and pump track.
quote: an 8.2 km mountain biking trail... novices to the sport should stick to the Northern loop... The Chestnut Pump Track caters to riders of all skill levels.

claim: Chestnut is Singapore's largest nature park with dedicated hiking and mountain-biking trails.
quote: Singapore's Largest Nature Park With Dedicated Hiking & Mountain Biking Trails.

claim: February-April is Singapore's driest stretch, best for hiking and outdoor activities.
quote: The best time to visit Singapore is February-April during the dry season... The driest months are February and March, making them ideal for outdoor activities.

claim: The wet NE monsoon (Nov-Jan) brings the most rain days; the Meteorological Service publishes monsoon updates.
quote: Forecast | Monsoon Update - Weather Information Portal.

claim: June-October carries transboundary-haze risk in Singapore, with peak severity July-September when PSI can exceed 150.
quote: Haze season typically spans June through October, with peak severity occurring between July and September when PSI readings frequently exceed 150.

claim: Labrador Nature Reserve offers an easy coastal and mangrove walk including the Berlayer Creek trail and Bukit Chermin boardwalk.
quote: Nature and coastal walk at Labrador Nature Reserve.

claim: Berlayer Creek is a 0.9km mangrove boardwalk plus 300m Bukit Chermin boardwalk, flat and easy, under an hour, free.
quote: a 0.9 km boardwalk, snaking alongside thick mangrove vegetation... takes less than an hour... level of difficulty being categorized as easy.

claim: Coney Island Park has a 2.5km park connector and forest/mangrove habitats explorable on foot or by bike, with 80+ bird species.
quote: The forest and mangrove habitats can be explored on foot or by bicycle... home to more than 80 species of birds.

claim: Coney Island has a recommended ~3.6km walking route and bikes can be rented near Punggol Jetty.
quote: a recommended 3.6km walking route... rent a bicycle nearby, with options like Go Cycling near Punggol Jetty.

claim: NParks runs free monthly Sisters' Islands intertidal guided walks with only 45 spots, released the first Sunday of the month and booked out fast.
quote: The FREE Sisters' Island Marine Park intertidal walk is organised by NParks monthly... ONLY 45 spots per session... released on the first Sunday of the month.

claim: NParks Chek Jawa guided tours are one hour, cost S$60 and take up to 15 people.
quote: one-hour tours... Each tour costs $60 (maximum 15 people per group).

claim: Mega Adventure operates the MegaZip and other aerial activities on Sentosa.
quote: Official Website - Mega Adventure, Sentosa.

claim: The MegaZip flies 450m from Imbiah Hill to Siloso Beach at up to 60km/h from a 75m launch.
quote: The MegaZip launches from 75 meters high and flies 450m from Imbiah Hill to Siloso Beach at speeds up to 60km/h.

claim: The Singapore Cable Car round-trip SkyPass costs about S$35 adult.
quote: A round-trip Sky Pass for an adult costs S$35.

claim: The Mount Faber line cable car ride takes about 26-30 minutes.
quote: the Mount Faber Line ride can range from 26 to 30 minutes.

claim: Ola Beach Club at Siloso offers walk-up kayak and stand-up paddle rentals plus jet-ski and banana-boat rides.
quote: a range of thrilling watersports activities... Kayaking... Stand-Up Paddleboarding... Jet Ski Activities.

claim: Ola Beach Club kayaking and SUP require age 7+ and basic swimming skills.
quote: Age requirement is 7+ for standup paddleboarding and kayaking, and basic swimming skills are required.

claim: Pulau Hantu is Singapore's home reef ~45 min by boat, rich in nudibranchs but with low 0.5-5m visibility and mild current.
quote: visibility ranges from 0.5 - 5 meters... largest biodiversity of macro life, especially the nudibranchs... expect a mild to low current.

claim: Guided Pulau Hantu dive trips are bookable through PADI-affiliated operators.
quote: Singapore | Pulau Hantu Dive Trip | Book online | PADI Adventures.
